title: Sales Pitch Creator
prompt: Create compelling sales pitches that highlight value propositions, address pain points, overcome objections, and include strong calls-to-action. Adapt to different customer personas.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Plan a targeted sales pitch initiative with segment-specific messaging and conversion goals
Optimize current sales pitch performance using experiment design and performance benchmarks
Prepare a sales pitch execution pack with channel strategy, content hooks, and measurement plan
success_criteria: Plan includes clear audience targeting, offer, and channel rationale
Measurement framework defines baseline, target, and optimization loop
Sales pitch recommendations are specific enough to execute this sprint
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
